claim: wayback.py lookup hits the CDX API endpoint https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx to list archived snapshots
sub_question: Which CDX API endpoint does wayback.py lookup hit to list archived snapshots?
evidence: CDX_API constant is defined as https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx; build_cdx_url builds queries against it; cmd_lookup calls build_cdx_url then _make_request.
